[LGRA.7.6a] The optional `gap_policy` phrase (`gap hold|zero|skip`)
follows `time_model`. Its words `gap`, `hold`, `zero` and `skip` are
reserved ([LLEX.9.5]). The grammar accepts the phrase on any series
line, but it is valid only on a time-integrating aggregation (`integral`)
and defaults to `gap hold` when omitted; applicability and default are a
compile-time contract per [LSER.13.5.1].
